planets.name: TOI-1117 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1117 with a 2.23-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-1117 b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around TOI-1117. Its orbit and size follow Lockley et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
